comparison.objective: Candidate fractures HELICOIL tangs and collects them; record breaks a seized pulley loose with two pry bars and removes it.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires a stabilized narrow mandrel, discrete hammer impulse, lateral-load avoidance, and fragment recovery; record requires bimanual levering with two pry bars and pulley extraction.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate has explicit four-fracture, containment, retention, damage, release, and stability checks; record evidence only establishes loosening and removal, without detailed force/damage thresholds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest impact/force-related record, but sustained two-point prying to extract an intact pulley is meaningfully different from notch fracture followed by tiny-fragment recovery.
